question: The western cyclonic disturbances in India are brought in by the westerly flow from which region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mediterranean region.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **western cyclonic disturbances** in India are brought in by the** westerly flow** from the Mediterranean region.
 
• Hence,** statement 2 **is **correct.**
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 are** incorrect **as they are not sources of **western cyclonic disturbances **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Cyclonic disturbances** are** low-pressure system**s that bring in moisture from the Mediterranean region and** cause rainfall** in India.
 
• They usually occur during the **winter months of November to March**.
 
• These disturbances are important for the **agriculture sector **as they provide much-needed water for crops.
 
• The intensity of the rainfall depends on the **strength of the disturbances** and their **location.**
 
• South-American region
 
 
• The South-American region is **not** a source of western cyclonic disturbances in India.
 
• The westerly flow from this region **does not **reach India.
 
 
 
• Eastern European region
 
 
• The Eastern European region is **not** a source of western cyclonic disturbances in India.
 
• The westerly flow from this region** does not** reach India.
 
 
 
• South-African region
 
 
• The South-African region is **not **a source of western cyclonic disturbances in India.
 
• The westerly flow from this region **does not **reach India.
